quotes.persona_label: 25-34 solo from Germany, luxury budget, first timer, planning months 1 3, via app; interests: scenery, hiking
quotes.stimulus_title: Experience the best cruises in Milford Sound
quotes.text: Fairly likely, and I'd probably go for the fly-and-cruise or the Ultra Premium cruise with the gourmet meal and reserved seating. Since I'm a first-timer and travelling solo on a luxury budget, I like that the page spells out the boarding point and has a compare block for the cruise types, and the 4.8 from over 6,000 travellers plus the free cancellation and guarantees make me comfortable booking in the app. What holds me back is that it's a marketplace with no clear statement of who actually runs the cruise. Several listings also don't show a price, and the weather cancellation policy is vague. I'd want to check that the product page spells out the refund terms and the exact departure time before I pay, because I don't want to lose a flight-based day to fog or cloud.

quotes.persona_label: 35-44 family with kids from United Kingdom, budget budget, first timer, planning weeks 1 4, via mobile_web; interests: short_on_time, scenery
quotes.stimulus_title: Experience the best cruises in Milford Sound
quotes.text: As a budget family of four doing this for the first time, I like the 4.8 rating from over 6,000 people and the free cancellation. The cruise-only options at 155–179 NZD look doable, and it's reassuring that cruises usually run in the rain and strollers are allowed. What would stop me is the cost per person adding up, and I can't tell whether kids get a discount. The Queenstown day trip at 309 NZD each is a 12-13 hour day with little ones, and I'm not sure if we'd drive ourselves. I'd probably go further down the page to check child pricing and the transport, so I'm leaning towards booking but won't do it straight away on my phone.

quotes.persona_label: 25-34 couple from Australia, budget budget, repeat, planning months 1 3, via desktop; interests: wildlife, short_on_time
quotes.stimulus_title: Experience the best cruises in Milford Sound
quotes.text: I'd probably book from here, since I've done Milford before and I'm mostly after the Nature Cruise for the seals and the odd penguin or dolphin. The 4.8 from over 6,000 reviews, the 24-hour free cancellation and the clear boarding point all help, and the 155 NZD cruise-only option works for a budget couple. What holds me back is that the Nature Cruise has no price showing, and I can't tell from this page who actually runs it, since it's a Headout marketplace listing and not the operator's own site. I'd open the operator's own site in another tab to compare prices, and then book here only if it's about the same. We're short on time, so I'd also want to know the drive from Queenstown fits the schedule before I commit.

quotes.persona_label: 45-54 friends from Australia, premium budget, first timer, planning months 1 3, via desktop; interests: short_on_time, photography
quotes.stimulus_title: Experience the best cruises in Milford Sound
quotes.text: I'm fairly likely to book, probably within a few weeks. The fly-and-cruise from Queenstown at 835 NZD suits me best: I'm short on time and want photos from the air as well as from the water, and my friends and I are on a premium budget. The Ultra Premium cruise with reserved seating is my backup, since a good deck spot matters for photography. What would slow me down is that the page doesn't say whether Headout is an authorised reseller, and some prices aren't shown. I'd also want the weather cancellation and flyover refund terms spelled out before I pay, since a cloudy day would waste a lot of money.

quotes.persona_label: 25-34 friends from United Kingdom, mid budget, first timer, planning weeks 1 4, via mobile_web; interests: weather_comfort, hiking
quotes.stimulus_title: From Queenstown: Milford Sound Scenic Flyover and Cruise
quotes.text: Honestly, I'm leaning towards not booking it as it stands. The flyover plus a small boat sounds like a brilliant first-time way to see Milford Sound, and hotel pickup and window seats are a big plus, especially if the weather turns grumpy and I want the best view. But 835 NZD is roughly £400 each, which is a stretch on a mid budget with friends. The listing doesn't name the operator or give a cancellation policy, and I've no idea what happens if the weather grounds the flight. The duration range of 4.5 to 13 hours is also vague. quotes.persona_label: 35-44 family with kids from New Zealand, premium budget, first timer, planning months 3 plus, via mobile_web; interests: wildlife, hiking
quotes.text:
I'm fairly interested, but I wouldn't book it yet. A small boat with a 75-passenger cap, close-up waterfalls, wildlife and a skipper who does commentary suits my kids and me, and the optional guided Milford Track walk is a nice bonus for a hiking family. Free cancellation up to 24 hours helps since I'm planning months out.

What holds me back is that the operator isn't named, so I can't tell which boat I'd actually be on. Pickup is also blank, and with kids I need to know how we get there from Te Anau or Queenstown, since that's a long day. A perfect 5.0 across 2,000+ reviews and a review count that doesn't match between pages make me want to check things on the operator's own site before paying 179 NZD each.
